about: Frozen P2-3 attacker artifacts. Pinned before the pilot; any change after the pilot makes a new arm. The attacker and control heartbeats are built from one template (frozen/sources/HEARTBEAT.template.md) so their protocol is identical; HEARTBEAT.md inlines the responder policy (D2R_ID_R0) and the tactic menu, since the runtime mounts only four workspace files. Built by scripts/pair_multi/spoof/adaptive/build_frozen.py.
